cards.why: Corwin Alder lives and will work in Denver from Mon 19 Oct. Colorado wages include wages paid to a Colorado resident, so Kestrelwick must hold a Colorado withholding account (Colorado Wage Withholding Tax Guide, revised January 2026: 'apply for and maintain an active Colorado wage withholding account'; it names no date). Payroll Harbor pays him from run R-2 (Fri 30 Oct), which closes Wed 28 Oct and is not released without the account

Linnea Tavares moved to Saint Paul, MN on Thu 1 Oct and has worked from there since; the roster and Payroll Harbor still say Oregon, and only change C-7 in the HR log (pending review) shows it. Minnesota taxes a resident's wages wherever she works (Minn. Stat. 290.92 subd. 1 and 2a), and the employer files its application 'on or before the date the employer is required to withhold' (subd. 24): the first Minnesota pay is run R-1 on Thu 15 Oct, which closes Tue 13 Oct (Mon 12 Oct is not a Payroll Harbor business day)

Since Thu 1 Oct all of Linnea Tavares's service has been done at home in Saint Paul, MN: 100 percent of the quarter's employment is in Minnesota (Minn. Stat. 268.035 subd. 12), and DOL's UIPL 20-04 telecommuting example puts wages in the state she telecommutes from, from the date she began. Minnesota asks for registration upon or before the first wage detail report (268.045 subd. 1), but Payroll Harbor releases run R-1 (Thu 15 Oct, closes Tue 13 Oct) only with the account

Corwin Alder will perform all his service at home in Denver, so it is localized in Colorado (C.R.S. 8-70-117). Kestrelwick becomes a Colorado employer on paying wages of $1,500 or more in a quarter (8-70-113): Payroll Harbor expects about $19,000 this quarter from run R-2 (Fri 30 Oct), which closes Wed 28 Oct and is not released without the Colorado accounts

Imani Vasquez will perform all her service at home in Austin, localized in Texas (Labor Code 201.043). Kestrelwick becomes a Texas employer on paying $1,500 or more in a quarter (201.021): about $14,000 is expected this quarter from run R-3 (Fri 13 Nov), which closes Tue 10 Nov
